crossRefs.note: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors, to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the…
I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels; one hundred…
They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to Yahweh, on horses, in chariots, in…
Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints…
The crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Heldai
people.line: A returned exile who helped crown Joshua.

people.name: Jedaiah
people.line: Returned exile who provided silver and gold for crowns

people.name: Josiah
people.line: One who provided silver and gold for a crown

people.name: Tobijah
people.line: Postexilic Jew who provided silver and gold for crowns

people.name: Zephaniah
people.line: One of the men in Zechariah's prophecy

translations.web: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.
translations.bsb: “Take an offering from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon—and go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
translations.kjv: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
translations.asv: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, whither they are come from Babylon;
